verdict.rationale: telli documents a dedicated API endpoint to import phone numbers from your own SIP trunk provider with custom SIP termination settings. Its phone-numbers docs also describe connecting an existing number and phone system for inbound and outbound calls via SIP trunk access, so users are not locked to bundled telephony. Missing for 10: explicit Twilio/Telnyx-specific import documentation, detailed SIP configuration specifics (auth, codecs, origination), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can connect my own carrier or PBX via SIP trunking (or import Twilio/Telnyx numbers) instead of being locked to bundled telephony

citations.quote: Imports a phone number from your own SIP trunk provider. This allows you to use existing phone numbers with telli by configuring custom SIP termination settings.
Connect an existing number and phone system for incoming and outgoing calls. You need SIP trunk access from your provider.
